title: fix(plugin-detail): a record:activity whose types leaves out comment offers no comment composer
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-steve"} -->
_Requested by **Steve** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi9?thread=cmsg_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi9M74fmRwo3N4LF8cXvJSwDE)_
Fixes #34371

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- **改了什么**:活动块(`record:activity`)的 `types` 不含 `comment` 时,不再显示评论输入框和「仅评论」筛选项;开发环境下对每个块提示一次原因和两种改法。
- **为什么改**:HotCRM 线索页的活动块写了 `types: ['task']`,评论被这个白名单过滤掉,但输入框照常显示,用户发的评论保存了却永远看不到。
- **风险与回滚**:只影响 `types` 写了且不含 `comment` 的活动块;没写 `types` 或含 `comment` 的块完全不变。回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- **先看**:`ui/packages/plugin-detail/src/renderers/record-activity.tsx`(新增 `commentsShown` 判定与告警);`ui/packages/plugin-detail/src/RecordActivityTimeline.tsx`(新 prop 收掉输入框与「仅评论」);`ui/packages/plugin-detail/src/renderers/recordActivityFeed.ts`(判定与告警文案)。
- **两分钟验证**:`pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run packages/plugin-detail/src/renderers/__tests__/record-activity.test.tsx`,预期 27 个全过,其中 5 个是本卡新增。
- **需要你做的**:无,席位落地。

## What changes

**Measured drop point.** The comments are not lost by the host. Reproduced through `RecordDetailView` rendering an authored record page (real `page:tabs` opened on its Activity tab, real `record:activity`) with HotCRM `lead_detail`'s `lead_activity` properties verbatim (`types: ['task']`, `limit: 20`, `showCompleted: true`, objectstack-ai/hotcrm main `07d5d9f`). The host reads `sys_comment` and `sys_activity` and builds the comment items with `type: 'comment'`; the block then runs them through `applyFeedConfig` (`recordActivityFeed.ts`), whose `types` allow-list step (`kept = kept.filter((i) => allowed.has(i.type))`) drops every `comment`, because `'comment'` is not in `['task']`. That is what the spec declares (`RecordActivityProps.types`: "Feed item kinds to show (default: all)"). The defect is that the same block still offered the composer (`showCommentInput` defaults to `true`) and the Comments only option, so a posted comment was stored and then filtered out of view.

**Ruling.** Seat ruling 6915056720 on the dev report 6915007777 picked option C for this card: refusing the contradiction at authoring is spec-lane card #34383, and the producer fix (`'comment'` added to `lead_activity`'s `types`) is carried to hotcrm. Option B (making `types` skip comments) was declined.

**This PR (option C, `Metadata-protocol: none`).**

- `recordActivityFeed.ts`: `feedTypesAdmitComments(types, block)` answers whether the authored `types` can show a comment, through the same `normalizeFeedTypes` reading `applyFeedConfig` filters by, so the answer and the rows cannot disagree. `warnWithheldCommentComposer` names the block (and its node `id`), its `types` and both fixes, once per block and `types` (the `warnOnce` channel the file's other diagnostics use).
- `record-activity.tsx`: computes `commentsShown` and hands it to the timeline; where the composer would otherwise have been offered (`showCommentInput` not `false`), it warns from an effect, in development only (the package's `isDevBuild` spelling).
- `RecordActivityTimeline.tsx`: one optional prop, `commentsShown` (default `true`). `false` withholds the composer and the `comments_only` filter option; an authored `filterMode: 'comments_only'` then reads as `all` under the existing "a filter the dropdown does not offer filters nothing" rule. `RecordChatterPanel` passes nothing and is unchanged.

A block with no `types`, or a `types` that includes `'comment'`, renders exactly as before.

## Tests

New top-level `describe` in the block's existing harness, `renderers/__tests__/record-activity.test.tsx` (real renderer, real timeline, a host `DiscussionContext` with an `onAddComment`):

- the HotCRM shape (`types: ['task']`) draws no composer and no Comments Only option (and the comment is not shown);
- CONTROL `types: ['task', 'comment']`: the composer and the option stay, the comment shows, no warning;
- CONTROL no `types`: the same;
- the warning fires once across a re-render and a remount, naming the block, its `types` and both fixes;
- a block with `showCommentInput: false` is told nothing.

No forced test edits: no existing test changed.

<details><summary>Pin run and ablations (fix commit 76ea4fd8)</summary>

- `pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run packages/plugin-detail/src/renderers/__tests__/record-activity.test.tsx`: Tests 27 passed (27).
- Ablation 1, `record-activity.tsx`, `commentsShown` forced `true` through `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` (anchor 1 to 0, blob moved): Tests 2 failed, 25 passed; the HotCRM-shape pin and the warn-once pin went red; restored, blob equal to HEAD, `git diff HEAD` empty.
- Ablation 2, `RecordActivityTimeline.tsx`, the `comments_only` option gate forced open: Tests 1 failed, 26 passed ("expected [ 'All Activity', …(3) ] to not include 'Comments Only'"); restored, blob equal to HEAD.
- The pins import the block from `src` (relative imports), so no `dist` rebuild sits between a mutation and the run.

</details>

## Acceptance notes

- HotCRM `lead_detail` keeps hiding its comments until the producer adds `'comment'` to `types` (carried to hotcrm by the seat ruling); this PR removes the composer that posted into the void. The same page's comment saying `scheduled` rows are dropped is stale (they map to `event` now), and `types: ['task']` hides those too.
- The probe that measured the drop point through `RecordDetailView` was a one-off and is not committed.

## Verification

All local runs on the final head `879d3661` unless named.

- `pnpm --filter @object-ui/plugin-detail type-check` (`tsc --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json`): lock VERDICT command-exit 0.
- `pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2 packages/plugin-detail/`: Test Files 379 passed, 1 skipped (380); Tests 3402 passed, 18 skipped (3420); lock VERDICT command-exit 0.
- `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack`: 38 commands derived, each run, each `exit 0`; `--ran` reconciliation: "38 derived famil(ies) accounted for — 38 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED". The record is in the project files as `ui-seat2/34371-gates-ran.txt`.
- CI-only families (Type Check UI, Test UI shards, Build & E2E UI and the rest): read from this PR's check-runs.
